article.title: 25 Years of the “War on Terror” w/ Silky Shah & Darakshan Raja
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: In the aftermath of the September 11th, 2001 attacks, the US government enjoyed broad, bipartisan support for mounting what President George W. Bush termed a “War on Terror.” We were told that “war” required new tools, new techniques, and new resources to fight a global, asymmetric foe–one that maybe was lurking inside the United States, and that was driven by a supposedly civilizational grudge… Source
